hero.eyebrow: Bat Trang · a seven-hundred-year pottery village
hero.title: Every piece of pottery carries the seal of its maker.
hero.lead: vCraft takes you into the workshops of the craft village's households. Watch them work, scan the seal under a piece to see every step it went through, then order straight from the maker.
hero.vaseAlt: A garlic-shaped vase in blue glaze

day.title: A day in Bat Trang
day.lead: From kneading clay to opening the kiln, six steps that every piece goes through. Swipe sideways to follow each one.

artisans.title: The hands that keep the craft alive
artisans.lead: Every household has its own story, its own glaze and its own way of shaping clay that nobody else shares.

map.title: Which workshops are open?

stats.title: The village in numbers
stats.years: Years the village has kept the fire

clay.name: Kneading
clay.text: The clay is filtered, rested and kneaded until every air bubble is gone.

throw.name: Throwing
throw.text: The clay goes on the wheel and the maker's hands pull it into shape.

dry.name: Drying
dry.text: It dries evenly in the shade so it won't crack in the kiln.

paint.name: Painting
paint.text: Patterns are brushed on by hand with blue underglaze.

glaze.name: Glazing
glaze.text: How thick the glaze goes on decides the shine and the shade of blue.

fire.name: Firing
fire.text: The kiln climbs past 1,200°C. Only when it opens do you see how the glaze turned out.

finish.name: Out of the kiln
finish.text: Each piece is checked one by one and sealed underneath before it leaves the workshop.
